description.zh: 获取实例指标的结束时间。
description.en: The end of the time range to query.
The instance ID. You can call [ListInstances](~~470439~~) to obtain the instance ID.

description.zh:
实例指标类型，取值如下：
- GpuCoreUsage：GPU使用率。
- GpuMemoryUsage：GPU Memory使用率。
- CpuCoreUsage：CPU使用率。
- MemoryUsage：Memory使用率。
- NetworkInputRate：网络写入速率。
- NetworkOutputRate：网络写出速率。
- DiskReadRate：磁盘读取速率。
- DiskWriteRate：磁盘写入速率。
description.en:
The metric type. Valid values:

- GpuCoreUsage: the GPU utilization.

- GpuMemoryUsage: the GPU memory utilization.

- CpuCoreUsage: the CPU utilization.

- MemoryUsage: the memory utilization.

- NetworkInputRate: the network ingress rate.

- NetworkOutputRate: the network egress rate.

- DiskReadRate: the disk read rate.

- DiskWriteRate: the disk write rate.

description.zh: 获取实例指标的起始时间。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query.

description.zh: 指标获取的时间间隔。单位为分钟。
description.en: The interval at which metrics are returned. Unit: minutes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dsw get-instance-metrics --instance-id dsw-730xxxxxxxxxx --metric-type GpuCoreUsage --start-time 2020-11-08T15:00:00Z --end-time 2020-11-08T15:00:00Z --time-step 15m --api-version 2022-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
